async def act(page):
    # Click on the issues link for the project 'Byte Blaze / a11y-syntax-highlighting'
    # The link has name '5' and url '/byteblaze/a11y-syntax-highlighting/-/issues'
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='5', exact=True).click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')  # Wait for the issues page to load
    
    # On the issues page, click the 'New issue' button
    # Assuming the button has role 'button' and name 'New issue'
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='New issue').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')  # Wait for the new issue form to load
    
    # Fill in the title field
    # Typically, the title field is a textbox with role 'textbox' and maybe name 'Title'
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title').fill('Support for Webagent in Hugging Face dataset next quarter?')
    
    # Fill in the description field
    # The description might be in a textbox or a contenteditable area; using a generic selector
    # Assuming it has role 'textbox' and name 'Description' or similar
    description_text = "Do you have any plans on supporting Webagent in the next quarter in Hugging Face dataset?"
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description').fill(description_text)
    
    # Submit the issue by clicking the 'Submit issue' button
    # Assuming the button has role 'button' and name 'Submit issue'
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Submit issue').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')  # Wait for submission to complete
    
    # After submission, we might be redirected to the new issue page
    # No further action needed as the task is to create the issue
    return "Issue created successfully."
